verdict.rationale: HumanLayer is a SaaS/agent-orchestration platform with a CLI and cloud service, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question to ask of it. However, no evidence documents an OpenAPI or equivalent spec. Probes of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and the official CLI is a different capability that does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
